== Notes ==
* Vengeful Weapon's life stealing occurs before the target ally takes the damage or life stealing.
* If damage with no source, such as the [[Madness Dart]] in [[Jokanur Diggings]], is taken, the life stealing from Vengeful Weapon is dealt to the target ally.
* When being attacked by [[minion]]s, the summoner receives this skill's life steal. If the [[Masterless minion|minion is masterless]], the life stealing will be dealt to the minion.
